name: Real Darbuka
summary:
Real Darbuka brings real percussion into your room.

PLAY WITH YOUR HANDS
• A darbuka that answers how hard and where you hit: dum, tak, tek, slaps, and the other hand muting the skin.
• Many darbukas, frame drums, djembe, bongos, tabla and handpans, each built from the real instrument.
• A full drum kit played with the controllers: sticks, hi-hat pedal, kick on the trigger or a USB MIDI pedal.
